summary: P1 (standards, probe): a change that was deferred when its subject shipped is refused later as SHIPPED, so a human cannot drop it. ship_moves/shipped count every version that moved to shipped with the change on change_ids, but a deferred change stays on that list (closed changes are read as absent only by the gate folds). Real binary, 24b8194a6: approved chore red -> change defer -> subject move --to shipped (ok, shipped without the chore) -> change drop bump-client = CHANGE_CONFLICT SHIPPED 'already shipped ... with it on its change list, after its brief was approved'; same after a reopen + defer. This blocks F2 (drop a deferred change) for any subject that ships while the change waits, which is the F7 first use (gate-trust-spine reopened and shipped again with canon-0-41-ci-nextest deferred). Fix: in ship_moves skip a version written while the change's latest change_state before version.at is deferred/dropped; add the defer -> ship -> drop case to change_drop_06. Blast radius: reopen is not gated by shipped, so a reopened change can no longer be deferred again either.
